tools.name: calculate_ziwei_chart
tools.description: Compute a complete Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數) natal chart from birth date, birth time or shichen index, and gender. Returns Ming Palace (命宮), Body Palace (身宮), Five Elements Bureau (五行局), Soul/Body Masters, BaZi pillars, Ming Palace San Fang Si Zheng (三方四正), all 12 palaces with stars/brightness/Four Tran

tools.name: calculate_ziwei_horoscope
tools.description: Compute Zi Wei Dou Shu time-layer overlays — Decadal (大限), Yearly (流年), Monthly (流月), and Daily (流日) luck palaces, heavenly stems, earthly branches, and Four Transformations (四化) — for a natal chart on a target date (defaults to today in UTC+8).
